title: Operations SLA Automation + Escalation Notifications
businessRequirement: Connect the staging-accepted Operations Action Queue/SLA controls to ANCLINE's existing workflow-automation and notification engine so operational tasks can generate deterministic at-risk/overdue escalation events, in-app notifications and controlled escalation tasks without changing booking, finance, payment, document or release lifecycle rules.
objective: Move from manually visible SLA state to governed proactive operational follow-up using the existing WorkflowAutomationService, NotificationRule, EscalationTimer, Task, AuditEvent and IntegrationEvent structures.
preservedChangeRequests: CR-20260923-001 — Operations Control + Exception Dashboard — staging acceptance PASS
CR-20260923-002 — ECOM resilience hardening — preserve approved API hardening behavior
CR-20260923-003 — Operations Action Queue + SLA Escalation — staging acceptance PASS
impactedModules: existing WorkflowRule, NotificationRule, EscalationTimer, AutomationNotification, Task, AuditEvent and IntegrationEvent data

impactAssessment.web: REQUIRED — surface escalation/notification state inside the accepted Operations Control + Action Queue without replacing the frozen layout or navigation model.
impactAssessment.api: REQUIRED — add narrow integration between task SLA transitions and the existing workflow-automation trigger/timer/notification engine, preserving idempotency and scope enforcement.
impactAssessment.shared: REQUIRED — API escalation state, queue presentation and role visibility must stay consistent.
impactAssessment.dataMigration: NOT_REQUIRED — reuse existing IntegrationEvent-backed WorkflowRule, NotificationRule, EscalationTimer and AutomationNotification records plus Task/Audit data.
impactAssessment.securityPrivacy: REQUIRED — internal-only automation dashboard and notifications remain booking scoped; external roles must not receive or query internal operational escalation details.
impactAssessment.financeReleaseControls: NO_RULE_CHANGE — escalation may notify about payment/release blockers but cannot override, clear or mutate finance/release security decisions.
impactAssessment.workflowCompatibility: REQUIRED — automation creates coordination signals/tasks only; no automatic booking lifecycle transitions.

triggers: Task enters AT_RISK within the configured SLA warning window
Critical Operations Control exception remains unacknowledged beyond configured threshold
Assigned task remains unresolved at escalation due time
automation: Use deterministic idempotency keys per task + escalation stage to prevent duplicate escalation
Create in-app AutomationNotification records using existing NotificationRule behavior
Use existing EscalationTimer records for delayed escalation
Use existing runDue processing for due timers, with booking scope enforcement
Optionally create escalation Task records through existing automation behavior without duplicating the original queue task
Record every trigger, notification, timer execution and escalation action in existing audit/integration evidence
escalationLevels: LEVEL_1 — assigned owner reminder / at-risk notification
LEVEL_2 — overdue notification to owner plus configured Operations Manager or CONTROL_TOWER audience
LEVEL_3 — persistent critical exception escalated to CONTROL_TOWER visibility, without granting broader mutation rights
userExperience: Show escalation level/status and latest notification state in the existing Operations Action Queue
Provide direct link to existing job/action surface
Do not introduce a separate competing operational workflow screen

regressionPlan.rule: Planning only. If later BUILD_APPROVED, classify as SHARED and require Web/API build gates, full role/privacy browser UAT, responsive/failure/accessibility, transaction lifecycle, resilience/security regression, CR-003 Action Queue E2E and targeted SLA automation/notification E2E before staging deployment approval.

acceptanceCriteria: CR-001 Operations Control categories/counts/filters/direct links remain intact.
At-risk and overdue queue tasks trigger only the configured automation stage and do not create duplicate notifications or escalation tasks on retry.
Escalation timers execute through the existing idempotent workflow-automation engine.
GLOBAL_ADMIN, CONTROL_TOWER, BRANCH_OPS and FINANCE see only escalation data permitted by existing booking scope and role rules.
CUSTOMER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE and AGENT cannot access internal SLA escalation notifications or automation controls.
Escalation does not modify booking lifecycle, document release, finance, payment, carrier release or NVOCC/Forwarding privacy rules.
Every automated escalation action is auditable and traceable to the original task/booking/control exception.
Full SHARED regression plus targeted SLA automation/notification E2E must pass before staging deployment can be approved.
approvalRequired: Explicit user approval of CR-20260923-004 business requirement and scope before any implementation.
notes: DRAFT ONLY. Preserve CR-003 staging-accepted runtime 82994ab813ed40e0aac799ff2fd119a7035f4b9a and the canonical JOB_DONE baseline. No build, staging deployment or production promotion is authorized.
